title: Create: Springs
body: ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3566990a037a82f2c4158b110fe2ed7d4f7c451.png) # About: Create Springs is a large addon for Create that adds springs and spring related things, it allows for storing rotational force and there is a LOT of ways to use energy that stored in springs Addon has a compatibility with Sable(Create Aeronautics), springs are able to interact with sublevels if Sable is installed ## Content ### Springs Springs are main thing that addon adds,\ they have a lot of unique mechanics such as explosion charge ### Spring tools Spring-powered tools such as drill, saw, shove, fan are relativly balanced,\ create-styled alternative to vanila tools ### Additional mechanisms there is several mechanisms that can help you to process blocks, transmit charge or manage redstone signals ### Spring Alloy it is a new material used in recipes of this addon, there is also several decorative blocks made of it ### Gear there is additional Gear with several functional abbilityes such as Steam dash ## JEI compatibility: ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4079a338110f993145f2842ed1c381255b652e59.png)
